title: A kit service file
description: One file per service, written by its package's install under ~/.sessionkit/<package>/services/<name>.json, or <group>/<agent>.json for one per agent. `sessionkit service` reads it; the kit writes none.

service.description: The marker: this file is a service, and its schema version.

name.description: The short name every verb takes: the label after dev.sessionkit.<package>.

label.description: The launchd label, under dev.sessionkit.<package>., where <package> is the folder the file sits in.

run.description: Instead of label: the command of a foreground service with no launchd job. Listed; the kit never starts it.

enabled.description: The owner's word that this Mac should run it. Its install writes true, its uninstall false.

install.description: The owner's command that installs it.

kind.description: An on-demand job runs and exits, so no pid is its healthy idle.

hazard.description: call: a stop or restart can drop a live phone call, so it is refused during one unless --force.

agent.description: The agent a per-agent service serves.

logs.description: Logs beyond the plist's StandardOutPath and StandardErrorPath.

order.description: Order inside a group restart, lower first.

note.description: One line the owner wants shown.
